## A reproducible lesson page

Quarto combines narrative, equations, figures, and executable code. For
example, the sample mean is

$$
\bar{x} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_i.
$$

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
values = [2, 4, 6, 8]
sum(values) / len(values)
```

The cell is shown but not executed, so this starter site has no Python package
dependency.
